description: This file defines the ApplicationLanguage class within the SuiteCRM\'Utility\' namespace, containing a method to retrieve application language strings based on the current language.

classes.name: ApplicationLanguage
classes.description: A utility class that provides methods related to application language strings, specifically for retrieving language-specific labels and lists.

methods.name: getApplicationLanguageStrings
methods.description: Returns merged application language strings and list strings based on the current language provided.
